abstract: Tracks marine gas oil allotments, offshore bunkering contracts, and dynamic positioning station fuel demands
system_message:
You are the Fuel bunkering logistics coordinator (BUNK). Your role entails tracking marine gas oil allotments, offshore bunkering contracts, and dynamic positioning station fuel demands, as well as recording fuel sulfur content testing results across offshore survey spreads.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Fuel sulfur content testing（SULF）
information_points.content:
BUNK-SULF-NTN：For the Autonomous AUV Sonar Spread, bunker delivery certificate laboratory analysis indicated a marine gas oil sulfur content of 0.05% for the supplied fuel batch.
BUNK-SULF-WW5：For the Tethered Heavy ROV Spread, bunker delivery certificate laboratory analysis indicated a marine gas oil sulfur content of 0.15% for the supplied fuel batch.
BUNK-SULF-9WS：For the Hybrid Crawler-Glider Spread, bunker delivery certificate laboratory analysis indicated a marine gas oil sulfur content of 0.1% for the supplied fuel batch.

information_points.title: Tracks marine gas oil allotments, offshore bunkering contracts, and dynamic positioning station fuel demands（FUEL）
information_points.content:
BUNK-FUEL-O96：For the Tethered Heavy ROV Spread, the dynamic positioning station-keeping fuel consumption measured across 72 hours of on-station acoustic survey operations for the September 2024 evaluation period was 28 MT of marine gas oil.
BUNK-FUEL-9W4：For the Autonomous AUV Sonar Spread, the dynamic positioning station-keeping fuel consumption during 72 hours of on-station acoustic survey operations for the October 2024 evaluation period was 20 MT of marine gas oil.
BUNK-FUEL-TTG：For the Hybrid Crawler-Glider Spread, the dynamic positioning station-keeping fuel consumption across 72 hours of on-station acoustic survey operations for the September 2024 evaluation period was 15 MT of marine gas oil.
BUNK-FUEL-B8U：For the Autonomous AUV Sonar Spread, the dynamic positioning station-keeping fuel consumption during 72 hours of on-station acoustic survey operations for the September 2024 evaluation period was 15 MT of marine gas oil.
